Sandbox_CannabisMod_GrowthSpeed_tooltip: Multiplier on how fast cannabis plants grow. 2.0 is twice as fast.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_HarvestQuantity_tool: Multiplier on buds and seeds from each harvest.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_MaleSeedChance_toolt: Percent of new seeds that are male. Males never flower into buds and are used for breeding.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_DryingHours_tooltip: Game hours a wet plant needs on the rack to dry fully. Rushing it lowers quality.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_CuringDays_tooltip: Days in a curing jar to get the full quality bonus.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_MoldChance_tooltip: Multiplier on the chance of mold while drying and curing. 0 disables mold.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_LampRange_tooltip: Multiplier on how far grow lamps reach. 1.0 is the default range.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_LampsNeedPower_toolt: If enabled, placed grow lamps only work on powered squares (grid or generator).
Sandbox_CannabisMod_EffectStrength_toolt: Multiplier on the mood and need changes from being high and from withdrawal. 0 removes the effects.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_ToleranceRate_toolti: Multiplier on how quickly tolerance builds with use. 0 means no tolerance.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_DependencyEnabled_to: If enabled, regular use builds dependency and stopping causes withdrawal.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_DependencyRate_toolt: Multiplier on how quickly dependency builds with use.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_LootRarity_tooltip: Multiplier on how often the mod's items appear in world loot (0 = none). Applies to newly generated containers.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_RecipeMagazine_toolt: If enabled, the mod's crafting recipes must be learned from the Grower's Handbook magazine. If disabled, every character knows them from the start.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_RootRotRisk_tooltip: Multiplier on how fast root rot builds in hydro systems and spreads through RDWC. 0 turns root rot off.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_ReservoirUseRate_too: Multiplier on how fast hydro reservoirs drain, use up nutrients and go stale.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_HydroQualityBonus_to: How far above 100 an RDWC grow's quality can reach (0.15 = up to 115). 0 removes the Top Shelf tier.
Sandbox_CannabisMod_PumpsNeedPower_toolt: If enabled, hydro air and water pumps only run with power. Without air, roots start to rot.
